svg.title: Tiled Map Builder MCP
svg.desc: Banner: an isometric crypt room built from the project's sprites, with the project title and its technologies: TypeScript, Node.js, Model Context Protocol, Tiled, Zod, Hugging Face FLUX, NVIDIA Nemotron.
svg.text: Let AI agents compose isometric Tiled maps:
rooms, corridors, traps and spawns, saved as .tmj.
